verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a full OpenAPI spec, CLI, and MCP server, and its core concepts (collections, source connections, search) are documented as API-first primitives that the UI is built on top of, suggesting strong API/UI parity. However, there is no explicit documentation or independent confirmation stating that every UI action (e.g., webhook configuration, Connect widget setup, auth-provider linking) is fully replicable via API. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that all admin/UI-only features (billing, org settings, Connect widget config) are API-accessible, and independent verification of parity.
